exactConstraintQuotes: The lengths of strings a and b are from 1 to 5 characters, inclusive.
characters A, B, ..., Z correspond to numbers 10, 11, ..., 35.
Note that on Mars any positional numeral systems with positive radix strictly larger than one are possible.
publicStatement.explanation: No lost exponent constraint or absent image/question. Scalar clock bounds 0..23/0..59, digit mapping, leading zeroes, and unlimited radix agree with the original English statement. Source bytes are unchanged.

constraints.layout: Exactly one a:b line; a,b each 1..5 ASCII digits or uppercase Latin letters; LF, CRLF or missing terminal newline accepted.
constraints.base: All integer radixes >=2; every digit must be less than the radix, no cap at 36.
constraints.output: Unique sorted integer token sequence, or sole 0 / -1 sentinel. Output whitespace is permitted; order and multiplicity are checked.

oracle.efficient: Map symbols to digits; if all non-units digits of both parts are zero, return -1 only if constant clock values are legal. Otherwise enumerate bases max(2,maxDigit+1)..59 using Horner evaluation. A nonconstant part has a nonzero coefficient at exponent >=1, hence is >=base; all finite valid bases are <=59.
oracle.independentReference: Generate legal hours 0..23 and minutes 0..59 in each base by repeated quotient/remainder encoding, skip unavailable remainder symbols >=36, compare canonical strings after removing leading zeroes. At base 60 all representable clock values are single digits, so matching that base proves the input is constant and valid for unbounded larger bases. No shared Horner evaluation or answer() call in the inverse reference.

coverage: both components at maximum legal length 5
all 36 one-symbol hour and minute values
leading zeroes and constant invalid hours
fixed-seed small polynomials and full-alphabet/asymmetric lengths

sourceMotivations.observation: Static inspection: declares all constant-looking pairs infinite without validating the hour; begins base search at max digit, not max digit +1. Motivates 00O:00000 and 22:00. No execution or kill claim.
Static inspection: uppercase letters take ord(char)-48, and base starts at the max digit itself. Motivates exhaustive alphabet and base/digit boundaries. No execution or kill claim.
Static inspection: only searches range(minimum,36), and infers infinity from filling that truncated range. Motivates 0:10, 0:11, 0:1N, and 0:Z. No execution or kill claim.

notCountedAsProof: No selected source executions, 5AC/5WA claims, sixth-oracle choice, sandbox kills, or audit/signoff. Presentation, CRLF, TLE-only, debug, and nondeterministic failures are not used as algorithmic evidence.
